newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY WEAKER ON MOST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY WEAKER ON MOST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Monday's session easier on most hard currencies on the back of slight import pressure, but was stable at Friday's levels against the rand, foreign exchange dealers said.
"It was a fairly quiet market today with thin trading being recorded," one dealer said.
"There was a bit of import pressure and the (Zimbabwe) dollar could have gone the other side (depreciated more) but we had a few receipts which stabilised the market," he added.
The local unit ended the day softer at 10.2975/3175 against the U.S. dollar compared to Friday's 10.2900/3100 and was also softer at 16.0110/0460 from 15.9900/16.0100 versus pound sterling.
It slipped to 6.7970/8140 from 6.7800/8100 against the mark but was little changed against the South African rand at 2.2800/2860 from 2.2800/2900.
